title: Pros and Cons
text: Pros and Cons. Doesn't stay hot very long, about 1 1/2 hours. Stays cold all day, ice is even still present the next day! The seal moves off the "track" every time you remove the lid. It did happen to fall over in my bag and a small amount spilled out on my sweater, but not much at all. Overall, I'm happy with the Zibtes 30oz insulated tumbler. It keeps my iced coffee iced cold all day, and it's very sleek looking.

product_metadata.title: Zibtes 30oz Insulated Tumbler With Lid and Straws, Stainless Steel Double Vacuum Coffee Tumbler, Powder Coated Travel Mug for Home, Office, Travel, Party (Glitter Black 1 pack)
features: STAINLESS STEEL INSULATED TUMBLER: It is made of food-grade 18/8 stainless steel. The interior is electro-polished. The outer layer of the roller is a lacquer process, with some sequins added to make your tumbler sparkle.
